name: Steelsnap
summary: In Thousand Needles, Melor Stonehoof sends you after a hyena whose pack terrorizes the wildlife. Steelsnap's hunt breaks with the usual reasons tauren take a life.

sections.title: A Hunt Outside the Blessing
sections.body: Tauren hunters take life for sustenance, honor, or wisdom from the Earthmother. Melor Stonehoof asks you to hunt Steelsnap for another reason. The hyena is seen as a threat to nature's balance, bringing senseless violence and fear instead of keeping the cycle of life.

sections.title: The Scourge of the Needles
sections.body: Steelsnap roams the canyons of northern Thousand Needles, south of the centaur enclave at Camp E'thok. Fierce hyenas follow him, and together they attack the gentler wildlife on the canyon floor. Slaying Steelsnap and bringing back his rib will end his hold over the needles.

faq.q: Why does Melor Stonehoof want Steelsnap killed?
faq.answer: Melor Stonehoof wants Steelsnap killed because he threatens the natural balance with senseless violence. Tauren hunts usually serve sustenance, honor, or wisdom from the Earthmother; this one aims to stop his attacks on the wildlife.
Steelsnap roams northern Thousand Needles, south of Camp E'thok, the centaur enclave.

faq.q: What proof must be brought back to Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Bring Steelsnap's Rib to Melor Stonehoof on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff.
No. Other hyenas follow Steelsnap and fight at his side.

faq.q: How does this hunt differ from traditional tauren hunts?
faq.answer: Tauren hunts usually serve sustenance, honor, or wisdom from the Earthmother. This hunt aims to stop a predator that disrupts the natural balance.
Melor Stonehoof lives on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff, where he instructs hunters and tests seasoned trackers.

angles.text: For the Shu'halo, taking a beast's life carries spiritual weight. Hunting Steelsnap teaches you to cull a creature whose cruelty falls outside the Earthmother's grace.
Hunting Steelsnap tests your skill at tracking down a savage pack leader among the hyenas roaming the canyon floor.
Clearing a safer path through Thousand Needles protects supply lines and travelers heading from the Barrens toward Shimmering Flats.
